descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S24 「按模式和 Generate 时的模板定计费系列（徽章永远不决定）」 Billing family by context and template at Generate (the badge never decides)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1d The billing family follows the context's templates, as a fixed table keyed on the template selected at Generate (not the badge). …（UAT TC-21 step 1；UAT TC-21 expected (billing)；UAT TC-18；TFA-92599 rule 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U9 Nursing Home has Save & Extract, a billing block and a Medications panel, all working (none were present in Run 6)（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • T3 Creating a custom template requires the mandatory type field (one of the 8 types, or Procedure/other). The type drives billing like a stock template (TFA-92596), and 'Procedure / other' gets no billi …（TFA-92599 AC 8；UAT TC-18） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Synthetic notes sent through the app's billing step exactly as the app sends them after Generate (same cells as TC-18 S03/S04, cut to the context axis)

When Run the billing step once per cell

Then Each code comes from the template's family in the UAT TC-18 table; an NH note never gets a 9922x/9923x code; overriding the NH badge's template moves the family with the template; a custom template's type drives the family; 'Procedure / other' gets no code

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：codeIn = the template's family (exactly one CPT code in the output, from the list); mustNotInclude the other context's families; noCode for Procedure / other. A decision table, not an AI check: the 10-scenario threshold of 3.2 for billing quality is TC-18 S13–S16. Local stack, direct action calls; E2E_AI_LIVE is not involved.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
